target: 100% backend services; correlation/request/tenant IDs on applicable events

api.notes: request id: header, all lines of a request; NOT sent on outbound HTTP calls or put into queue jobs. tenant: tested with a simulated guard, not a real JWT. redaction: headers, URL, query, error text; free-text business logs not scanned. volume: 2556 Nest route-mapping lines at every boot.

worker.notes: same base options (service=worker), asserted by unit test, worker process not booted here. Outbox lines now carry the id of the request that wrote the event. BullMQ jobs carry no request id.

node_bridge.notes: a module inside the API process (apps/api/src/modules/node-bridge-runtime), not a separate service: it logs through the API logger. No outbound id propagation.

web_nextjs.notes: no server logger; 6 files use console.* (mostly browser side). The auth route handlers forward or create x-request-id; the proxy does not. Open.

partner_app.notes: apps/partner does not exist in this checkout.

cli_tools.notes: terminal tools (console.* allowed by the ratchet test). The fatal process handler writes the same JSON shape.
